articleTitle: Multimodal Sentiment Analysis using Audio and Text for Crime Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Thanks to the advancement of communication technologies and the widespread use of social media networks, individuals generate daily a significant amount of data that contains valuable emotional information. During the last few decades, most of the research in sentiment analysis has concentrated on textual sentiment analysis, which has been accomplished through text mining techniques. Audio sentiment analysis, on the other hand, is still in its infancy and started to attract the scientific community. In this paper, we use the XD-Violence dataset to develop a multimodal learning model that predicts crimes by incorporating both audio and text modalities into the same model. As an initial step, we benchmark the dataset on audio using CNN (Convolutional Neural Network) and RNN (Recurrent Neural Network) before moving on to text using BERT (Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers). Finally, we combine CNN and BERT to get the best results with an accuracy of 85,63 %, a loss of 30,47%, and an F1-score of 85,16%.

articleTitle: Comparative study of YOLOv3 and YOLOv5's performances for real-time person detection
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Deep learning algorithms have recently gained traction in smart cities and societies, such as in healthcare, surveillance, and in a variety of artificial intelligence-based real-life applications. Person detection is a big challenging task in modern computer vision applications. Thus, human appearances can be difficult to judge, as there are major differences in human postures and appearances. This paper discusses the performances of YOLO algorithms, especially YOLOv3 and YOLOv5 for person detection as a tool to enhance the security of public places in smart cities. To evaluate the performances, a challenging dataset called Penn-Fudan is used. Experimental results reveal that YOLOv3 outperforms YOLOv5 in terms of speed. However, YOLOv5 had the best recognition accuracy.

articleTitle: The influence of predictive maintenance in industry 4.0: A systematic literature review
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: In the production process, managers are always forced to make decisions to improve and meet the needs of the plant, so it is important to maintain the machines and their equipment at the right time is one of the major challenges. The Predictive maintenance has an ability to maintain in real time so it has an advantage over several features such as downtime, costs and production quality. This article is a systematic review of the literature on the study of the challenges of the Predictive maintenance and give a new classification of this field of research. It was found that 4.0 and Predictive maintenance technology is still present in most areas.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of the NiO as hole transport layer in CH3NH3PbBr3 perovskite based-solar cell using SCAPS-1D
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: With the SCAPS-1D simulator, a full digital simulation and modeling on the perovskite solar cell was performed using the perovskite methylammonium lead tribromide material MAPbBr<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> for various parameters such as open circuit voltage (V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">oc</inf>), fill factor (FF), power conversion efficiency (PCE) and short-circuit current density (J<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">sc</inf>). The electronic properties of the MAPbBr<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> material used as the active layer were calculated. The effects of NiO layer concentration, MAPbBr<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> layer thickness and temperature on photovoltaic parameters on perovskite solar cell (n-ITO/ n-PCBM (ETL)/ p-MAPbBr<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>/p-NiO (HTL)) were examined. The simulation of the solar cell based on perovskite MAPbBr<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> allowed us to find the following values <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\mathrm{V}_{\text{oc}}=1.0476\ \mathrm{V},\ \mathrm{J}_{\text{sc}}=7.9745\ \text{mA}/\text{cm}^{2},\ \text{FF}= 77.85\%,\ \text{PCE}=6.5\%$</tex>). Our results were compared with published experimental values and also simulated by SCAPS-1D, and they showed good agreement.

articleTitle: Evaluating Systems Reliability With A New Method Based on Node Cutset
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: To compute system reliability, many approaches are available in the literature. One of the most used approaches is the enumeration method, minimal paths or minimal cuts. Most of these approaches enumerate the minimal paths to evaluate reliability, but few of them used minimal cuts. This paper proposes a new direct method that enumerates all the minimal cuts with nodes failure. Unlike the algorithms in the literature that use indirect methods based on finding minimal paths to extract the minimal cuts from them.

articleTitle: Integration of Lean Manufacturing in Industry 4.0: An overview of tools and applications
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Industry 4.0 (I4.0) is an innovative advancement able to modify the production sector, maximize movement, flexibility, and production adaptability. As a result, companies become more flexible and improve their processes based on the evaluation of instant state data and, consequently, optimizing production. This feature is particularly required in the current era, where the demand of mass production of highly customized products results in increasingly complex products, requiring a higher flexibility of production systems. Lean Manufacturing (LM) and high automation are currently two strategies for addressing these issues. The aim of this research study is to provide an overview on the I4.0 tools that are currently implemented in LM by companies, presenting main achievements, strategies, and related advantages.

articleTitle: Performance Study of Artificial Neural Network Training Algorithms for Classifying PV Field Defects
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Diagnosis is an essential technique that fits into the field of industrial systems maintenance. In this article, the diagnosis is applied to the photovoltaic field to increase energy efficiency. The development of a diagnostic system based on intelligent approaches, such as an artificial neural network is necessary to ensure the efficiency and control of photovoltaic systems automatically and intelligently. Artificial neural network demonstrates their effectiveness in detecting and identifying faults in PV systems. In this paper, the neural network used for classification has been trained with different learning algorithms to show which is the most efficient and accurate algorithm for classifying PV field defects.

articleTitle: Spectral feature extraction from EEG based motor imagery using common spatial patterns
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Noninvasive MI-BCI (Motor imagery Brain computer interface) allows people to communicate and control external devices through EEG signals. Feature extraction is an important bloc to obtain a reliable classification accuracy of motor imagery tasks. Common spatial patterns (CSP) is a frequently used algorithm for EEG feature extraction, but its performance relies on the subject-specific frequency band. This paper shows the powerful effect of CSP in discrimination between two classes of motor imagery (left and right hand). Using projected training data on CSP this study demonstrates that subject-specific frequency bands can easily be determined. The experimental results obtained using two public EEG datasets (BCI competition IV dataset 2a and 2b) demonstrate that the subject-specific frequency bands extracted in offline analysis phase using CSP help improve the classification performance of MI-BCI.

articleTitle: Air Quality Forecasting using decision trees algorithms
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Forecasting air pollution is crucial as it not only affects the physical health of people but also provides guidance for pollution control. Particulate Matter with a diameter of less than <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$2.5\mu m$</tex> (PM<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2.5</inf>) is one of the major contributors to air pollution which can cause acute and chronic effects on human health. Forecasting PM<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2.5</inf> involves various meteorological factors as well as the influence of historical data. Therefore, the prediction of the surface PM<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2.5</inf> concentration is of great importance for the protection of human health. This study uses machine learning models, namely Decision Tree (DT), Random Forest (RF), and Gradient Boosting Regressor (GBR) to predict PM<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2.5</inf> hourly scale concentrations, using meteorological data and PM<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2.5</inf> concentrations from adjacent stations. The dataset was collected in the city of Beijing in China as a study region. The experiments have shown that the gradient boosting regressor model achieves higher predictive precision than the other models proposed for estimating hourly PM<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2.5</inf> concentrations with an <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$R^{2}$</tex> value varying between 0.9 and 0.97. This work offers a promising and affordable approach to robustly predict PM<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2.5</inf> concentrations.

articleTitle: Experimental Validation of a New Power Chain for Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Currently, electric vehicles (EVs) present a promising solution to environmental and energy challenges. But their conventional power chain still has limitations on their performance. This paper proposes a new structure based on an open-end winding induction motor fed by a dual inverter. The aim of this work is to develop a reliable mathematical model of the new power chain and its control strategy in MATLAB/Simulink and carry out an experimental validation of this structure on a laboratory set-up using the dSPACE 1104 board. The simulation and experimental results obtained demonstrate the reliability of the model and the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: A new multi-band fractal antenna using a triangular measured on the 1GHz to 6GHz band
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: This article examines the many properties of a new fractal antenna design based on triangular fractal geometry. The suggested antenna is built on a cheap FR4 substrate with a relative permittivity of 4.4, a thickness of 1.6mm, and a dielectric loss tangent of 0.02. The High Frequency Structure Simulator is used to design and simulate the antenna (HFSS). The basic structure of the designed antenna is optimized by applying a 50 Ω impedance microstrip line feed technique to achieve the high value of return gain and loss. The simulated results of the proposed antenna reveal that the antenna operates on five operating frequency bands 1.84GHz, 2.77GHz, 2.94GHz, 4.33GHz and 5.79GHz of gain which can reach 6.01db and a VSWR which varies between 1 and 2 in the operating bands. The antenna is built and then tested with a VNA (Vector Network Analyzer). The experimental and simulated results are very close to each other.

articleTitle: Benchmarking of digital maturity models according to the dimension component
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Digital maturity assessment is a prerequisite for any digital transformation project. The assessment allows public or private organisations to know their current digital maturity levels in order to know where to start for their digital transformation projects. In this article, we conducted a qualitative and quantitative analysis of 30 digital maturity models identified in the literature in relation to the dimensions of an ontological model derived from the literature, which proposes 9 knowledge domains and 18 sub-domains that should be taken into account in any digital transformation project. These analyses made it possible firstly to check whether the knowledge domains proposed in the ontological model covered all the dimensions of the 30 models studied and secondly, these qualitative and quantitative analyses made it possible to determine the degree of usability of these knowledge domains by the digital maturity models identified in the literature.

articleTitle: Doc2Vec, SBERT, InferSent, and USE Which embedding technique for noun phrases?
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Phrase embedding is a technique of representing phrases in vector space. A very high effort has been made to develop this technique to improve tasking in various natural language processing (NLP) applications. The evaluation of phrase embedding has been presented in many studies, but most of them focused on the intrinsic or extrinsic evaluation process regardless of the type of the phrase (noun phrases, Verb phrases …). In the literature, there is no study evaluating the embedding of noun phrases, knowing that this type is used by many NLP applications, such as automatic key-phrase extraction (AKE), information retrieval, and question answering. In this article, we will present an empirical study to compare the most common phrase embedding techniques, to determine the most suitable for representing noun phrases. Dataset used in the comparison process consists of the noun phrases from the Inspec and SemEval2010 datasets, to which we have added their manually defined synonyms.

articleTitle: Using Bayesian Ridge Regression to predict the Overall Equipment Effectiveness performance
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: To be competitive in the market, each company tries to decrease all kind of waste in the production system, for this reason, the company try to put in place key performance indicators used to measure the company performance, one of the good indicators used is the overall equipment effectiveness (OEE). This study aims to predict the OEE using the supervised machine learning techniques, known by their ability to treat an important size of data, the supervised learning techniques will help us to treat the data and know the trajectory of the company performance. In our case, we have used the Bayesian Ridge regression algorithm. The results of applying this technique show a very high accuracy higher than 99%.

articleTitle: Covid-19 Classification Using HOG-SVM and Deep Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: COVID-19 is measured as the biggest hazardous and fast infectious grief for the human body which has a severe impact on lives, health, and the community all over the world. It is still spreading throughout the world with different variants which is silently killing many lives globally. Thus, earlier diagnosis and accurate detection of COVID-19 cases are essential to protect global lives. Diagnosis COVID-19 through chest X-ray images is one of the best solutions to detect the virus in the infected person properly and quickly at a low cost. Encouraged by the existing research, in this paper, we proposed a hybrid model to classify the Covid cases and non-Covid cases with chest X-ray images based on feature extraction, machine learning and deep learning techniques. Two feature extractors, Histogram Oriented Gradient (HOG) and CNN (MobileNetV2, Sequential, ResNet152V2) are used to train the model. For the classification, we utilized two approaches: Support Vector Machine (SVM) for machine learning and CNN (MobileNetV2, Sequential, ResNet152V2) classifiers for deep learning. The experimental result analysis shows that the Sequential model and the ResNet152V2 model achieve 100% and 82.6% accuracy respectively which is satisfactory. On the other hand, the HOG-SVM method successfully detects all the test images correctly which provides the best result with 100% accuracy, specificity, and responsiveness over a limited public dataset.

articleTitle: 3D Simulation of Natural Convection in a Cubic Cavity with Several Differentially Heated Walls
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Applications of convective heat transfer are very abundant in different fields such as industry, engineering, and everyday life. Given the importance of these applications, this paper proposes a three-dimensional numerical simulation of natural convection using a hybrid approach. This technique is based on the lattice Boltzmann method associated with the multiple relaxation time model for the treatment of the fluid flow and on the finite difference approximation for the temperature calculation. The thermal problem considered is the study of convection in a cubic cavity filled with air. The cavity is differentially heated by its different faces. The hybrid code used is validated by analyzing the free convection in a cubic cavity with two differentially heated walls. Different quantities such as velocity, temperature, local and average Nusselt numbers, and Rayleigh number are studied in this work to characterize the heat exchange between the fluid and the isothermal cavity walls.

articleTitle: Identification of switched reluctance machine inductance using artificial neuronal network
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: This paper aims, to presents a new method for identified the parameters of switched reluctance machine (SRM) using neural network and Hammerstein model. This latter, is consists of a static nonlinear block followed by a dynamic linear block. Thus, the inherent magnetic nonlinearity of the SRM must be taken into account by appropriate identification of the machine parameters. The model of Hammerstein is verified and compared to neural networks and polynomial method.

articleTitle: Energy Efficient PSO-based routing protocol for large WSN
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Energy efficiency is one of the biggest issues in Wireless Sensors Networks (WSN) especially in large areas. Routing topology consists of defining the routes for each sensor towards the BS. Clustering have been used to centralize data collection and transmission and showed remarkable improvement compared to directs schemes. In large monitored areas, and in order to avoid excessive CH's energy consumption, Multi-hop communication is used to route data to the BS. In this paper, we transformed the routing problem to an optimization problem proposing a PSO-based routing process taking into consideration the distance of transmission and the residual energy of CHs to optimize the overall routes to the BS. Based on a new fitness function, we managed to guarantee less traveled distance and the reliability of links, avoiding CHs death during process by relaying on residual energies as a factor to select routes. Our proposed PSO-based routing technique had optimized routes, stabilized the network, reduced the energy consumption and improved the number of packets received by 19.92% compared to MHT-LEACH, 64.46% compared to DEEC and by more than 81% compared to LEACH.

articleTitle: Breast cancer diagnosis using feature selection techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: This study focuses on feature selection for breast cancer diagnosis. Since the feature selection became a crucial task in machine learning, we will experiment some filter, wrapper approach and embedded approach on Wisconsin breast cancer dataset, which is commonly used by researchers who use machine-learning methods for breast cancer diagnosis. The performance of the feature selection method is evaluated by classification accuracy using two kinds of classifiers SVM and KNN.

articleTitle: Intelligent ANFIS controller of two cooperative 3-DOF manipulators: the case of manipulation under non-slip constraints
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: The control and modeling of mechanical systems, especially robotic manipulators, is a domain that currently obsesses many researchers. The goal of this work is to develop an intelligent control model of two 3-DOF manipulators handling a common object. This model will allow us to control the gripping force by an intelligent controller (ANFIS controller) under non-slip constraints. In the first step, we are interested in the class of rigid manipulators with a simple open chain with 3-DOF. We first present a detailed study of the models used for the control and command of cooperative robots, namely the geometrical, kinematic and dynamic models: direct and inverse. We will then simulate these models on MATLAB/Simulink in order to validate and improve our modeling.

articleTitle: Modeling and Simulation of Vibrational Energy Harvesting from Passive Car Suspension Subjected to Random Excitations
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Ambient vibration energy harvesting using piezoelectric sensors has attracted a lot of research interest for low power electronic systems, stand-alone wireless applications, and embedded systems (e.g., automobile applications). The energy harvested in this case depends not only on the vibration input level but also on the properties, the dimensions and characteristics of the piezoelectric harvester. This paper investigates the vibrations energy harvesting from passive car suspension using piezoelectric material. A theoretical quarter car model is developed and simulated using MATLAB Simscape multi-physics Toolbox. The study investigates the system's electromechanical behavior and evaluates the harvested electrical voltage and power when the suspension is subjected to different random excitations corresponding to the normalized-road classes.

articleTitle: Inspection of machining defects on mechanical parts using a computer vision system
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Mechanical parts are currently mass produced by machines that perform high-speed machining. The mechanical parts will be assembled in a machine with other components, and therefore there will be holes for screws, grooves etc… These parts must have a precise shape. If the machining and drilling are not done in the right place or with a small dimensional error in this case the assembly process cannot be completed. The manuel inspection is cumbersome and the efficiency is low. To overcome this problem, the non-contact defect detection process is the subject of this research. We proposed a real-time measurement technique using edge detection, dilation and erosion algorithms to remove noise and enhance the collected part image to make the information clearer, then compare it with the perfect model. This technique uses the OpenCV library and a Raspberry Pi 4 board. The experimental results show that the defect on the part can be effectively inspected, located and recognized.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of a Broadband MIMO-CP-OFDM Communication System in the context of 5G-and-Beyond-3GPP defined Fading Channels
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Recently, on behalf of study on channel model for frequency spectrum above 6 GHz up to 100 GHz, the “third generation” partnership project “3GPP Technical Recommendation” has defined three different models of multipath fading channels: EPA (Extended Pedestrian A), EVA (Extended Vehicular A), and ETU (Extended Typical Urban). In this paper, a broadband MIMO-CP-OFDM (Cyclic Prefix OFDM) communication system is simulated in the context of these multipath defined profiles, and for which various OFDM configurations in function of channel bandwidth are tested and evaluated using the MATLAB® environment. The simulation results are given to illustrate the performance of 2×2 MIMO-CP-OFDM. It has been observed that the performance improves when the number of subcarriers is large and degrades for broadband channels. Increasing the bandwidths of the MIMO-CP-OFDM channels increases their throughput capacities. Nevertheless, selectivity also increases, and performance will be more degraded as fading will be severe, and the increase in the number of OFDM carriers will remain unable to solve the problem.

articleTitle: Localization based on DGPS for Autonomous Robots in Precision Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: In recent years, self-driving systems have smoothly penetrated several sectors, including precision farming. In this context, the Regional Center for Agronomic Research (CRRA) of Settat is working on a project to develop a low-cost autonomous driving tricycle robot for Precision Agriculture (PA). The robot will allow us to perform various tasks, such as data acquisition and the management of operations using a prescription map. The localization of the autonomous robot is a critical part of promoting its use. This paper focuses on the implementation of a Differential Global Positioning System (DGPS) localization system. This low-cost solution is mounted using an Arduino coupled to a GPS module for acquiring localization data that will be served for robot guidance. The experimental results show that our system provides adequate localization accuracy for agricultural robots.

articleTitle: An Automatic Voice Disorder Detection System Based On Extreme Gradient Boosting Classifier
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: This paper describes our approach to develop an Automatic Voice Disorder Detection (AVDD) system that can diagnose the patient voice and determine if the voice is normal and healthy or disordered due to a certain pathology. Our system is based on the Saarbrucken Voice Dataset (SVD) to feed our machine-learning model, and exploiting the Mel Frequency Cepstral Coefficients (MFCC) as an extracted feature. For the classification, we chose the Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost) classifier.

articleTitle: Optimization of photovoltaic System using Mamdani and Takagi Sugeno MPPT Controls
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: This paper presents a comparative study between two types of maximum power point tracking (MPPT) commands: the artificial Fuzzy Logic (FL) based on Mamdani and Takagi Sugeno methods and the classical Perturb and Observ (P&O) command commonly used to track maximum power point for photovoltaic (PV) systems. The simulation of PV system, including a typical photovoltaic panel connected to a resistive load through a DC-DC boost converter and controlled by the proposed MPPT commands, is performed in Matlab/ Simulink environment for sudden change in irradiation level and constant temperature. The main results of simulation show that the suggested Fuzzy Logic MPPT commands (Mamdani and Takagi Sugeno) perform better than the classical P&O command. Indeed, the comparison of different performance parameters, such as: PV-system efficiency and response time to reach the MPP, show that Fuzzy Logic controller efficiency is about 99.84% for FL of Mamdani type and 99.83 % for FL-Takagi Seguno method. Also, it shows lower response time (21 ms) to track the MPP for rapid change in irradiation level compared to the conventional P&O method with 99.58 % in efficiency and 28 ms for response time. Furthermore, the proposed Fuzzy Logic (Mamdani and Takagi Sugeno) command reduces the oscillations obtained by the conventional P&O method and converges rapidly to Maximum power point.

articleTitle: Condensation Behaviors of Droplet under the Gravity Effect on Hydrophobic Surface by Using the Hybrid Thermal Pseudopotential LBM Model
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: In this paper, the multi-relaxation time pseudopotential lattice Boltzmann model (MRT-LBPM) coupled with the explicit 2-order Runge-Kutta scheme are used to model the phase change producing droplets that form on a surface of adjustable density and fall under the body force (Gravity). The choice of this model is based on the idea that the separation of the phases is performed automatically due to the pseudopotential function <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\psi(x)$</tex> that depends on the density of the coexisting densities in the system. This model is tested in the cases of wettability, Laplace's law and droplet condensation on a solid surface. The results obtained are compared with those obtained in the literature and show a good agreement with the latter. The aim of this work is to study the behavior of the droplet on a hydrophobic surface at temperature below to the critical temperature of the Van Der Waals gas during the time <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$t^{\ast}$</tex> which is presented as a characteristic time and namely the way in which the droplet leaves the wetting surface under the effect of gravity.

Author Keywords: Multi-relaxation time pseudo potential lattice Boltzmann model

articleTitle: Comparative study between Linear Quadratic Regulator and Fractional-Order robust controller for the ThreeAxis Attitude Control System of LEO satellite using reaction wheels
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: The attitude control system designates all the equipment and algorithms implemented autonomously on a spaceship. In satellites, the accuracy of the missions depends on the reliability and robustness of the controller it is one of the most important subsystems. The purpose of this paper is to design and apply a fractional-order controller specifically for the attitude stabilization of a Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite using reaction wheels. Real microsatellite parameters are used to test and run the fractional order controller, designed with MATLAB software which accurately stabilizes the attitude of the satellite system.

articleTitle: IoT Based Smart Agriculture Monitoring System with Predictive Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Integrating Internet of Things (IoT) techniques into different fields and processing data produced within it can effectively shape the future. In Precision Agriculture, the use of the IoT features helps to manage crops production by optimizing productivity and reducing environmental concerns based on prediction models. In this paper, an IoT-based agricultural monitoring system is proposed, which integrates principal component analysis (PCA) feature selection methods and neural network classification techniques for crop productivity prediction. Furthermore, the model system allowed a sensing network to collect data of some crops (Tomatoes, Potatoes, Etc.). The experimental results show that our proposed model system can make decisions more accurately.

articleTitle: A comparative study of Sentiment Analysis Machine Learning Approaches
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: This Support vector machine (SVM) is one of the most popular linear classifiers in machine learning. It thrives on pattern recognition, numeral prediction, and, of course, classification. SVM aims to maximize the margin between the classes by drawing a line (hyperplane in dimensions greater than 2) that distinctly classifies the data points of each class. In this paper, we will test the performance of SVM combined with the n-gram technique on different popular databases (sentiment140, Amazon reviews, etc.) by using multiple metrics: Accuracy, Recall, Precision and F1-score.

articleTitle: Bilingual Chatbot For Covid-19 Detection Based on Symptoms Using Rasa NLU
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Accessibility to medical knowledge andhealthcare costs are the two major impediments for the commonman. Conversational agents like Medical Chatbots, which aredesigned keeping in view medical applications can potentiallyaddress these issues. Chatbots can either be generic of specificin nature. Covid-19 is a communicable disease and earlydetection of it can let people know about the seriousconsequences of this disorder and help save human lives. In thisarticle, we present a specific text-to-text Chatbot that engagespatients in the conversation using advanced Natural LanguageUnderstanding (NLU) and Natural Language Processing (NLP)techniques using Rasa Framework, to provide a personalizedprediction based on the various symptoms sought from thepatient. The Chatbot handles two languages: Arabic andFrench, then according to the analysis result, it suggestsmeasures and actions be taken in order to serve life and preventthe spread of this virus which has devastated the whole world.

articleTitle: A Named Data Networking Stack for Contiki NG OS
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: The current Internet has become the dominant use with continuing growth in the home, medical, health, smart cities, and industrial automation applications which are enabled by smart objects (constrained devices). These devices sense, gather and actuate information in their deployed environment. This concept is called as Internet of Things (IoT). In other words, IoT phenomenon is an emerging technology enabling such applications in our lives. IoT is regarded as a fourth industrial revolution because of it extensive coverage of services and applications. Intrinsically, Internet architecture and protocols has become a natural approach to apply to IoT design. However, despite the success of the Internet architecture and protocols, recent research has been reporting the deficiencies of this approach. IoT-based applications demand content oriented services. However, Internet design is host-centric. This architectural departure has led the researches into design of Future Internet Architectures (FIAs). Among them, Named data Networking (NDN) is also emerging as a promising FIA where it fits the communication needs of IoT networks typically. As a result, NDN architecture and protocols are considered to be implemented for IoT devices. Nevertheless, there are only a few implementation exists currently. Because of all of these reasons, we have aimed to provide design and implementation detail of a light-weight NDN protocol stack, called as <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mu \text{NDN}$</tex>, running on Contiki Operating System (OS) for constrained IoT devices. Contiki is an OS that is developed for constrained IoT devices. In this study, an NDN protocol stack that can work on top of IEEE 802.15.4 link and physical layers has been developed and presented. As far as we know, there is no any fully-functional open source NDN implementation in Contiki OS.

articleTitle: DSP In the Loop implementation of an enhanced Direct Torque Control for Induction Motor drive
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: This paper deals with an enhanced Direct Torque Control strategy for induction motor drive. The proposed approach uses a more precise switching table based on twelve sectors and modified hysteresis controllers. Processor In the Loop technique is performed using MATLAB with Code Composer Studio and F28069M development board. Therefore, this work proposes an experimental validation of an enhanced algorithm for Direct Torque and flux Control. Also, it offers a comparison to the conventional Direct Torque Control strategy. Processor In the Loop results, show that modified Direct Torque Control strategy improves torque and flux dynamic and enhances waveforms quality. So flux and torque ripples and harmonic distortion of the currents are reduced.

articleTitle: Miniaturization Trends in Substrate Integrated Waveguide for Microwave Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Substrate integrated waveguide structure is an emerging candidate for the components operating within the microwave and millimeter-wave communication system due to its multiple advantages: compact size, low losses, and low fabrication cost. Recently miniaturization of SIW is taking place day by day. In this article, the link of full-mode SIW (FMSIW), eighth-mode SIW (EMSIW), and sixteenth mode SIW (SMSIW) has been presented with their additional advantages. This paper may be a guideline of the analysis of recent miniaturization of substrate integrated waveguides and it can provide a design guideline of microwave components especially in small-size systems.

articleTitle: Event-related desynchronization identification using continuous wavelet transform-SINGLE
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Event-related desynchronization (ERD) and event-related potentials (ERPs) are two commonly observed phenomenons in the ongoing electroencephalogram (EEG) during internal or external triggered sensory, motor and cognitive events. Time-domain averaging is a widely used method to increase the signal-to-noise ratio and to detect some event-related cortical activities such as ERPs. However, this approach has drawbacks, where it's incapable of catching other types of events (e.g., ERD). To overcome this issue, we will consider an alternative approach. In this regard, time-frequency analysis (TFA) of the EEG using the continuous wavelet transform has been extensively used to explore different brain responses including ERPs and ERD.

articleTitle: Torque Control of Switched Reluctance Motor Using ANN-PID Controller
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: This paper aims to investigate the perfection of conventional tools, as well as the application of intelligent tools for switched reluctance motor (SRM) modelling and torque control with high performance. In most cases, SRM is used in saturation mode, since its winding is separate this type of motor has torque ripple. In this paper a new method of minimizing torque ripples is proposed. Asymmetrical half bridge converter (AHB) is used to feed both fuzzy logic and ANN control of a switched reluctance motor. Fixed SRM settings are used to simulate both controllers in MATLAB/ SIMULINK. In comparison to the ANN controller, the fuzzy logic controller drives the switching reluctance motor very well, according to the results.

articleTitle: Integration of Visual Management in the Industry 4.0: Case Study
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: The new industrial revolution which called industry 4.0 will radically change the factories into a smart manufacturing. The industrial business will profit in terms of effectiveness and perfection and avoiding the valueless labors by many factories. Immediately upon the fourth revolution appearing, new solutions are needed to cooperate the technology of Internet with the visual Management (VM) tool. The objective of this paper is to analyze the link and the integration between Industry 4.0 and VM tool based on case study and solutions tools which are proposed. In fact, the VM will be an important part of this revolution. This study identifies the challenge of the integration of VM in industry 4.0 and discusses the possibilities of their adaptation. The implementation of VM in this new industry (VM 4.0) is required to manage the difficulties of the connected industry solutions and to keep the explosion of information flow caused by internet of things in the right way. The results achieved by combining the Industry 4.0 with Visual Management show the benefits of the use of these technologies for managing industrial issues and increasing productivity.

articleTitle: Damage Modeling of Composites Laminate Containing Stress Concentrations
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: The purpose of this work is to evaluate the failure of an open-hole composite laminate subjected to tensile loading, including both initial damage and damage propagation, using failure criteria and progressive damage models. In order to accurately capture the effect of different specimen sizes on the failure load and failure mode of the AS4/PEEK composite laminate, a user material subroutine (UMAT) based on the failure criteria and washer coupling update method was implemented in Abaqus. In addition, a mesh dependency study of the present model was performed using different meshes. a comparison was made with the present model, the integrated Abaqus model and those available in the literature. The experimental results and numerical predictions were found to be in strong agreement.

articleTitle: Numerical investigation of the PCM effect on the performance of photovoltaic panels; comparison between different types of PCM
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Currently, the use of phase change materials (PCM) for the purpose of cooling photovoltaic modules has attracted a great deal of attention, since PV-PCM technology not only increases the efficiency of PV panels but also permits the extraction of thermal energy stored in the PCMs for use in cascading. In this paper, the effect of an RT58 type PCM with a heat sink on the cooling of the photovoltaic panel has been investigated, and a comparison has also been made between the effect of two other types of PCM, namely RT42 and C22-C48. To be more realistic, a UDF (user defined function) subroutine, written in C++, was developed to integrate the evolution of the ambient temperature and solar radiation of a summer day in the city of Oujda (eastern Morocco). These studies were performed by numerical simulations using ANSYS fluent software to solve the conservation equations, in order to optimize the temperature distribution and the liquid fraction of the system. The study showed that the integration of PCM decreases the temperature of PV cells to 21.2°K, 26.1°K, and 18.3°K for PCM types RT58, RT42, and C22-C40, respectively.

articleTitle: Public key cryptosystem and binary Edwards curves on the ring F2n[e], e2 =e for data management
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Let <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbb{F}_{2^{n}}[e]$</tex> be a finite ring of characteristic 2, where <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$e^{2}=e$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$n$</tex> is a positive integer. Let <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(a, d) \in\left(\mathbb{F}_{2^{n}}[e]\right)^{2}$</tex>, sach that <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$a$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$d+a^{2}+a$</tex> are invertible in <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbb{F}_{2^{n}}[e]$</tex>. In the present paper, we study <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$E_{B, a, d}\left(\mathbb{F}_{2^{n}}[e]\right)$</tex>, the binary Edwards curve over the ring <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbb{F}_{2^{n}}[e]$</tex>. More precisely, we give a bijection between this curve and the product of two binary Edwards curves defined on the finite field <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbb{F}_{2^{n}}$</tex>. Afterthat we study the addition law of binary Edwards curves over the ring <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbb{F}_{2^{n}}[e]$</tex>. We end this work with cryptography applications, ElGamal binary Edwards curve cryptosystem and Cramer-Shoup binary Edwards curve cryptosystem.

articleTitle: A Real Time Abysmal Activity Detection System Towards the Enhancement of Road Safety
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Nowadays, road accidents are a serious worry particularly in the developed countries where the rules and regulations are not maintained properly. The majority of traffic accidents are caused by the drivers' error or hostile behavior against the drivers inside the vehicle. In a nutshell, any type of abysmal action occurring inside the vehicle can result in a traffic accident. If these behaviors can be detected in real time, unexpected accidents can be reduced in a significant manner. Due to the increasing frequency of road accidents over the years, it has attracted the researchers' curiosity, and they are attempting to mitigate the abysmal activities inside the vehicle. In this regard, the deep learning algorithms can present a real-time abysmal activity detection system for inside use in a vehicle with the goal of reducing road accidents and thus increasing the passengers' safety. In this investigation, a dataset of abysmal activity inside a vehicle has been created, consisting of 10400 diverse photos divided into 9 classes. To the best of our knowledge, it is the largest dataset in this regard. Then, a real-time activity detection model called You Only Look Once (Yolov4) has been successfully employed, which obtained an outstanding accuracy of 99.402%.

articleTitle: Performance assessment of an improved high-gain-quadratic converter with single switch for solar PV systems
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: This work presents the performance analysis and the design of an improved controller based on quadratic boost converter with a single switch(QBCSS) designed for solar photo-voltaic systems. On the one hand, we will compare the traditional DC/DC boost converter often used in photovoltaic systems against the QBCSS on the basis of a high conversion ratio. The purpose of this comparison is to demonstrate the benefit of employing the quadratic boost converters with high voltage gain in PV systems. In the other hand, the effectiveness of MPPT approaches in PV system through a QBCSS is investigated using P&O and Fuzzy Logic (FL) based MPPT controllers. The findings results demonstrate that the FLC based MPPT regulator produces the best and most stable output when evaluated to the standard P&O method in the MATLAB/Simulink.

articleTitle: No-blocking Heliostat Field Layout in Tamanrasset
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: The present paper represents a case study of Tamanrasset city in terms of direct normal irradiance and wind speed, as well as an arrangement of 23 heliostats in a symmetrical field oriented to the North. A mathematical model of a graphical method for no-blocking heliostat field layout was followed to create an algorithm executed on MATLAB software in order to obtain the optimal positions of heliostats. The optical performance of the field was obtained by exploiting the heliostats' positions and the meteorological data of the chosen region based on Solar Pilot. The results show that the overall optical efficiency of the field is about 79% with a power output of 2066.5 (kW), as well as there is no blockage of heliostats.

articleTitle: Using Learning Analytics to Improve Students' Enrollments in Higher Education
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: In the last years there has been a growing interest in adopting learning analytics (LA) in higher and further education systems. LA assists the institutional stakeholders to enhance the learning process, ameliorate the teaching activities, make adequate decisions and take appropriate actions based on the collection, analysis, and reporting of data generated from individual learners. The learning analytics approach aims to achieve many objectives, one of them is prediction which is the center of this research. In this paper, we conduct a comparative study between three machine learning algorithms; Decision Tree (DT), Random Forest (RF), and Support Vector Machine (SVM); to predict the stream of new enrollments in the first year of higher education. As a case study, the predictive model is applied to new enrollments in the first year of the University Diploma of Technology (DUT) at the Higher School of Technology in Meknes, Morocco (ESTM). The performance of the classifiers is tested with and without the use of SMOTE data balancing on a dataset of 53554 students collected between 2016 and 2019. The obtained results show the best algorithm to predict the most accurate enrollments of students.

articleTitle: DFT study of the effect of injecting Lithium atom on electronic and optical properties of the C60
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: In this study, electronic and optical properties of the fullerene (C60) and the C60 with a Lithium atom inside (Li@C60) were investigated using the density functional theory calculations (DFT). We focus on such of these two carbon materials by reason of the appealing interest in the next generation of optoelectronic devices. The CASTEP code is used to optimize and calculate electronic and optical properties of the C60 and the Li@C60. The injection of a single Li atom inside the C60 cage leads to a decrease in its bandgap from 0.087 to 0.014 eV and changes the total density of states (TDOS), absorption coefficient, dielectric function, and refractive index. The peaks of the TDOS around the fermi level are very weak of these two materials. The existence of Li atom inside the C60 structure is highly influenced its electronic and optical properties. These results suggest the potential usage of alkali metals for controlling electronic and optical properties of the C60 material.

articleTitle: Analysis and comparison of PV hosting capacity mathematical models: A case study of a Moroccan distribution grid
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: The integration of distributed photovoltaic presents several advantages as well as certain disadvantages. To safely connecting PV installations into a given distribution network and maximize their benefits, it is necessary to assess their impact on that particular network. The maximum PV power that can be integrated into an electrical system without causing grid problems is defined as PV hosting capacity. This notion has been discussed in several research papers where various models to quantify it have been investigated. In this paper, a comparison of different mathematical models is performed. Then, the application of these models was performed on a medium voltage feeder of Morocco. The results of this present work show that the hosting capacity doesn't have a standard model, each single model depends on the limiting factors, assumptions, and grid parameters. This results in an over or underestimation of the hosting capacity of the studied feeder.

articleTitle: A new multilevel DC-AC converter topology with a reduced number of switches controlled by the multi-carrier sinusoidal PWM technique
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: In this paper, a new multilevel inverter topology is proposed with a reduced number of switches and no passive components. The proposed inverter generates a 7-level output voltage, capable of supporting high powers with minimum total harmonic distortion (THD) and involves a reduced number of switches. This paper elucidates the operating modes, voltage stress vices and number of voltage sources compared to conventional inverter topologies of the same number of levels. To improve the performance of our inverter the multicarrier sinusoidal PWM control (MSPWM) is used. The simulation results of the proposed inverter topology are checked using matlab/simulink have been analyzed with different types of control and modulation indices.

articleTitle: Real-time Software In the Loop Simulation for PID Control of the Nanosatellite Reaction Wheel
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: With the evolution and rapid development of numerical control technology, the application of automatic systems and algorithms has become more and more extensive and complex. Their functions have also gradually increased. In response to the growing and persistent demand for command and control testing, which requires more test time, resulting in a gradual increase in the cost of testing. Software In the Loop (SIL) simulation can save test time, reduce development costs, and prevent security risks. In this context, this paper describes a Software In the Loop simulation dedicated to the speed control of the reaction wheel used in the attitude control of nanosatellites. The co-simulation results between Scilab and Proteus softwares prove the speed and the good performance of the solution proposed for the control part by studying the behavior of the reaction wheel in different scenarios.

articleTitle: Modelling the design of the reverse logistics network for metal waste
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Waste management and processing is a global preoccupation. Everyone seeks to save the consumption of natural resources through the recovery and reuse of waste. The study of waste flows is among the current research topics in reverse logistics. One of the problems of implementing reverse logistics is the high cost of flow. Metal scrap comes mainly from industry, they are qualified as hazardous industrial waste requiring special treatment. In this article, we propose a linear programming model to optimize the processing flow of metal waste. The objective is to determine the efficient route of the reverse logistics which will allow to minimize the total cost of the operation of recycling of metals due to capacity constraints imposed. This cost is the sum of the transport and processing costs throughout the reverse chain.

articleTitle: Design of Low-Voltage Low-Power CMOS Second Generation Current Conveyor by using the Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: This article mainly aims at reducing the power consumption and optimizing the performances of CMOS positive second-generation Current Conveyor (CCII+) by using a biological-inspired algorithm named Genetic Algorithm (GA). The optimized CCII+ reduces the total power consumption by 25.5%. The optimal configuration of CCII+ is used as a building block of a relaxation oscillator. SPICE simulation results are presented to validate the good reached performances.

articleTitle: Model for maximizing fixed photovoltaic panel efficiency without the need to change the tilt angle of monthly or seasonal frequency
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Due to the variation of the solar inclination during the year because of the rotation of the earth around the sun. The angle of incidence of light rays varies between −23.45 ° (the winter solstice 21 December) and + 23.45° (the summer solstice 21 March) passing through the equator. With a fixed installation of a photovoltaic panel, it is preferable to be facing south and inclined at an angle equivalent to the location's attitude. However, to keep the performance of our panel to the maximum, it is necessary to change the angle of inclination every month or each season. This paper introduces a model to our photovoltaic panel, based on reflection by mirrors, to compensate for the loss of solar radiation at times of the year when it decreases. To validate the model, the results of the theoretical analysis are compared with the experimental results.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Model for The Selection of The Optimal Solid Waste Transfer Station Locations and for The Identification of The Optimal Transport Scenario
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: A multi-objective optimization model with binary variables is presented. This model can be used for the selection of the optimal solid waste transfer station locations and identifying an optimal transport scenario to minimize total cost, the number of vehicles required and greenhouse gas emissions generated by the transport of waste and providing information about the number, locations and capacities of operational transfer stations, the number of waste transport vehicles required, number of round trips and the road traffic generated in each waste transport trajectory. The model is programmed using Matlab and is applied to a hypothetical example. The model offers a graphical representation for the results of different possible transport scenarios verifying the conditions set to compare between them and choosing the desired scenario according to the user's interpretations of the results.

articleTitle: Experimental camera calibration study for 3D localisation
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: In this paper, we present a camera calibration technique, which consists in determining the intrinsic and extrinsic parameters of the camera. This approach has the advantage of being straightforward and uses simple objects from a 3-D scene (3-D test pattern). After the implementation of the approach, experimental tests were carried out in our laboratory, in order to evaluate intrinsic and extrinsic parameters of the camera. The experimental results obtained show the effectiveness of the approach used, in terms of precision of the 3-D localization. To further improve the accuracy of the results obtained, we have introduced a nonlinear mathematical model of the camera's optical distortions. Such precision is necessary for any application requiring knowledge of the 3-D environment of the said application

articleTitle: The conception of gas chamber for electronic nose
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: The gas measurement systems have a particular methodology, referred to as “Electronic Nose”, based on gas sensors as odor detectors. The current electronic nose (e-nose) chamber has design flaws, such as a big volume, an unwieldy construction, and so on. In this study, we aim to develop a gas chamber able to establish the good conditions of measurement by the sensor array, with consideration of the optimal shape of the gas flow and the positioning of the detectors, to acquire the measurements in a good state. The sensing chamber was designed using FreeCAD and simulated in ParaVIEW to characterize and determine the design capable to provide the optimum performance. Results show that the spherical shaped sensing chamber with a tangential arc connection from both pipes displayed the best performance in terms of the elimination of turbulence.

articleTitle: Study of direct shear of the adhesion connectors steel-concrete
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Throughout the world, several bridges need to be repaired, including replacing the concrete deck or the entire superstructure. Conventional decks are cast on site which involves closing down roads and / or deviating traffic and making detours which causes a lot of problems for road users over long periods of time. Using precast concrete slabs is a good alternative to the above, because the road closing time would be significantly reduced because slabs are fabricated in precast plant instead of on site. In this context a new type of steel-concrete shear connection is developed, known as connections by adherence, whose resistance is due to friction between various interfaces. The role of these connections is to minimize erection time considerably, and can consequently be used, for example, when replacing existing bridge decks, where the duration of on-site works has a significant influence on costs and traffic perturbations. The main objective of the paper is to verify this new connection, by developing a numerical model that explains the experimental results of a research carried out in the EPFL Steel Structures Laboratory (ICOM) in the interface formed by the cement grouts and the steel. To achieve this objective, in the beginning, we have conserved the same calculation hypotheses already studied by the laboratory, such as; the geometrical specifications and the mechanical characteristics of the embossed Steel and the Cement. Then, we changed the characteristics of the cement to verify the effect of the material on this connection.

articleTitle: Optimal Sizing of Integrated Inductor using a Hybrid Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: This paper proposes a hybridization of Differential Evolution algorithm (DE) and Ant Colony Optimization algorithm (ACO) named DE-ACO. The proposed algorithm has been evaluated in terms of solution quality, robustness, and computation time using three well-known benchmark functions. In addition, the DE-ACO algorithm was applied to generate the optimal geometrical parameters of a square spiral inductor to obtain better performance in terms of quality factor. EM simulations were performed using ADS Momentum to validate the obtained results.

articleTitle: Towards the Co-Design of a Teachers' Dashboards in a Hybrid Learning Environment
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Learning Analytic Dashboards support learning, and try to empower stakeholders to make better-informed decisions. While creating dashboards for teachers is common in Learning analytics, designing it with them is not that common, especially in hybrid systems and using data from both the online and face-to-face sessions. This paper will be discussing co-designing a teacher dashboard with teachers through participatory workshop and interview, after getting their goals and expectation for dashboard in hybrid system. To arrive to a dashboard prototype, conform with teachers' needs and expectations.

articleTitle: Additive Manufacturing Taxonomy Regarding Product Attributes
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: In many ways, additive manufacturing (AM) differs from traditional manufacturing in characteristics, benefits and limitations. To fully exploit the AM benefits, it is vital to determine the effect of AM process characteristics on a product's fundamental attributes to assist the designer in making the optimal choices and choosing the appropriate design direction. This article describes a taxonomy of additive manufacturing challenges encountered during the design phase. This taxonomy, which is used throughout the design process, acts as a checklist of manufacturing challenges that may be reviewed at the product definition stage.

articleTitle: Bidirectional On-Board charger based on the efficient topology Vienna Rectifier
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: This paper addresses the problem of the negative impact of the electrical vehicles on the grid and the low efficiency and power density drawbacks of the EV chargers. The solution is to choose the efficient topology of the Front-end rectifier in order to solve both the pollution of the grid by power factor correction, and the low efficiency of EV Charger by reducing the stress of the component which will reduce the cooling system needed and consequently increase power density of the system. This topology can be used in V2X charger. Modeling and control design of the front-end rectifier is investigated in the d-q reference.

articleTitle: Development of Wireless Anti-Electric Pilferage Automatic Transfer Switching with GSM Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Electric pilferage issues are common in the Philippines, especially in remote areas or among informal settlers. Because the detection is not easy and is mostly done manually, it can often cause a fire in the area. In that case, researchers pushed to develop an anti-electric piracy device. The primary purpose is to develop a device that can monitor the current flow of the power line and immediately notify the owner if anything unusual happens via SMS notification. The parameters to be considered are the difference in the pulley data that occurs between the transmission receiving part. All data were compared by Arduino Nano with a tolerance of +/- 0.4 Amperes. Upon completion of this project, the researchers conducted a variety of valuable tests, including wiretap sensing, switchgear trigger system, and notification from the GSM module. Everything included in the test is exposed to 100% functionality, which proves that this project is reliable from all parts, especially in sensing, triggering, and notification.

articleTitle: Performance improvement of a TEG by a heat transfer fluid
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: This This paper presents an optimization method to improve the performance of thermoelectric modules by managing their operating conditions. The studied mechanism, corresponding to an original configuration of the thermoelectric heat pump, includes thermocouples with channels in which water circulates in contact with both sides of the TEMs. The objective function is to regulate the temperature of the cold welds. In the first instance, a hot heat transfer fluid will flow through the thermopile at the hot welds, and then a cold heat transfer fluid will flow through the cold welds. The results obtained show that when the cold heat transfer fluid is added, better efficiency is obtained, and this is due to the remarkable temperature difference obtained.

articleTitle: Maximization of the assembly line efficiency using an approach based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Maximizing the line efficiency is a critical problem in manufacturing systems, it is known as the assembly line balancing problem type E in which the best couple of the number of workstations and the cycle time that maximize the line efficiency must be found. In this paper, the authors propose an approach based on the genetic algorithm to tackle the SALBP type E. Three different SALBP problems are generated to test the proposed genetic algorithm and obtained results are compared with those obtained by the Hybrid Reactive Greedy Randomized Adaptive Search Procedure.

articleTitle: A Machine Learning Approach to POS Tagging Case study: Amazighe language
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: The development of automatic processing tools for amazighe language is hampered by the lack of resources for these. In this sense, one of the main objectives of the work reported in this article is to provide this language with a morphosyntactic annotated corpus and a better precision system for morphosyntaxic labeling. To do this, we started by building our corpus of over 60,000 words. This was first used to carry out the lexical segmentation step. Secondly, this corpus made it possible to train the different models of machine learning and deep learning; in order to develop a part of speech (POS) tagger of amazighe language.

articleTitle: Towards an Artificial Intelligence Framework for Early Diagnosis and Prediction of Lung Cancer
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Lung cancer is the 3<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">rd</sup> most common cancer and the 1st cause of cancer death. It is the 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">nd</sup> most common tumor in men and 2nd in women, with approximately 32,300 and 16,800 new cases per year, respectively. In this context, the well-integrated of Artificial Intelligence in cancer research could improve early diagnosis and prediction for ensuring better health outcomes. In the present paper, an Artificial Intelligence framework for early diagnosis and prediction of lung cancer is presented, and different evaluation criteria are used in the experiment for estimating and validating the performance of our system. Various possible modeling methods can be used in this research work. In our case, the choice fell on Neural Networks (ANNs), Naive Bayes (NBs), k-nearest neighbors (KNN), Support vector machines (SVMs), Decision Trees (DTs), and Logistic regression (LRs). The experimental results showed that the Support Vector Machines provide a better prediction in terms of effectiveness and efficiency.

articleTitle: Modeling and simulation of a solar cell based on CIGS/CdS/ZnO
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: In this work, we studied and simulated a solar cell based on CIGS/CdS/ZnO. We have optimized the photovoltaic parameters by varying the thickness and the concentration of acceptors and donors of the different canapes of the cell. Simulation calculations have shown that the CIGS/CdS/ZnO based solar cell provides a photovoltaic conversion efficiency (PCE) of 16.20%. The results obtained are in agreement with what was achieved experimentally or theoretically with an equal or lower value, this is due to the different input parameters and to the defects related to the materials used in the simulated structure.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable Dual Band Microstrip Array Antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: The aim of this work is to design a frequency reconfigurable antenna array in order to evaluate its performance for telecommunication applications in the L, S and Ku bands. The operating dual resonant frequencies are f<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf>= 2.33 GHz and f2 = 14.86 GHz. In order to expand the number of operating frequency bands, the proposed geometry of the antenna array is based on standard antennas with identical rectangular slots at the patch. Varactor diodes are placed between the patch elements and the power line to provide reconfigurability in dual bands of operation. The commercially available HFSS EM solver has been used for the design and simulation purposes. The electrical control of the values of the integrated capacitors pushes the proposed antenna structure to operate at new resonant frequencies. Indeed, the operating frequencies of the antenna array vary continuously over a wide range ranging from 1.86 to 3.13 GHz and from 13.60 to 18.66 GHz.

articleTitle: Future 6G communication networks: Typical IoT network topology and Terahertz frequency challenges and research issues
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Wireless generations are standardized by the International Telecommunications Union (ITU) and occur approximately every ten (10) years. While the research work on the optimization of the 5G system is being developed in research laboratories, the studies of the concept of the future mobile generation 6G have begun. The 6G, whose beginnings are expected within ten (10) years, it would solve several problems such as the coverage of white or underserved areas. One of the candidate frequency ranges for 6G, THz should provide a very strong transmission of information (data rates) for future radio communication systems, especially for the communication system of Internet of Things (IoT). This paper aims to address the concept and the necessary components of wireless communications for the future 6G. The paper also presents the three (3) fundamental aspects which are Artificial Intelligence (AI), Mobile Ultra High Speed, and the Internet of Things (IoT). The THz band is the ideal candidate for broadband satellite radio communications and also for IoT. Current approaches, operating processes, and key challenges will be developed in this paper, as well as solutions. This paper shows what 6G technology could look like.

articleTitle: A Kalman filter with speed constraints for WiFi-based indoor localization
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: This paper presents a constrained Kalman filter for WiFi-based indoor localization. The contribution of this work is to introduce constraints on the object speed and to provide a robust test determining when to apply these constraints. The proposed approach is appropriate when the indoor environment is split into several areas, each area having its own variable organization. It is also applicable to objects that could be span around, as for example barcode readers in a hand. The proposed technique is experimented with a robot and three devices, on five different journeys, in a 6000m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> warehouse equipped with six Wi-Fi access points. The results highlights that the proposed approach provides a 17% improvement in the localization accuracy.

articleTitle: Performances of Robust Control of Doubly-Fed Induction Generator for Wind Energy Conversion System
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: This work presents a sliding mode control technique applied to the wind energy conversion system equipped with a doubly fed induction generator.
